lines: The race's world can be drawn four ways: Low, Medium, High and Ultra.
Low is the drawn look: toon shading, ink outlines and a flat sky. Every race opens here, so the picture never starts high and drops in front of you.
Medium brings physically based materials and shadows. High adds reflections, ambient occlusion and temporal anti-aliasing.
Ultra needs WebGPU. With WebGL 2, a world asked for at Ultra draws at High.
The levels are main's, with its table of fifty-four techniques. main opens the world at Low, so the requirement, the settings and the loading card now say the same.
From a phone to a desktop, the drawn look is the same world at every width.
What the tests prove: each level draws its own techniques, and Ultra on WebGL 2 draws at High. Break the cap, and the test turns red.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
